description: Retrieve aggregated usage statistics across the whole account, bucketed by time. Account id is resolved from the control token when ABLY_ACCOUNT_ID is unset. Control API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/stats.

account_id.description: Override the account id (defaults to the token's account).

end.description: End of range, ms since epoch (inclusive).

start.description: Start of range, ms since epoch (inclusive).

unit.description: Bucket size: minute | hour | day | month. Default minute.

name: ably_get_account_stats
title: Get account-level statistics
